info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v4-spec
info.description: This API enables users to unsubscribe from weather alert notifications. It allows consumers, such as individuals or organizations who wish to manage their notification settings, to easily remove their subscription to various weather alerts. By invoking this operation, users can control the frequency and type of alerts they receive. This enhances user experience by reducing unwanted notifications while still ensuring they receive critical weather updates as needed.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from receiving alerts. By deleting the subscription, users will no longer receive notifications or updates related to the specified alerts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to unsubscribe from alerts. It should contain the relevant parameters in JSON format to successfully process the unsubscribe request.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the unsubscribe operation to delete alerts. The request body is expected to be a string indicating the type of operation.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the unsubscribe operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the unsubscribe request.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the unsubscribe operation.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscribe request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's outcome.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for the unsubscribe operation indicating the result of the DELETE request.

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the user who created the unsubscribe request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the unsubscribe request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe request was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the unsubscribe operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken, in milliseconds, to process the request. This value can be useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
